vignette: A young child with early childhood caries has cavitated lesions in primary teeth. Definitive restorative care cannot be provided soon because access to it is limited.
stem: Which management approach best fits this situation?

options.text: Leave the lesions untreated because nothing can arrest them before definitive restoration.
Use 38% SDF as an adjunct within the individualized caries management plan.
Restrict SDF to permanent teeth and withhold it from primary teeth.
Apply SDF once and plan no further reassessment.
